fields.label: Google PageSpeed Insights API Key
fields.name: site_audit_psi_key
fields.instructions: Required for reliable results — without a key Google heavily rate-limits requests. Create one in Google Cloud Console (enable the "PageSpeed Insights API"). Prefer defining DS_PSI_API_KEY in wp-config.php (it overrides this field and keeps the key out of the database).

fields.label: Email the report to the prospect
fields.name: site_audit_email_prospect
fields.instructions: Sends the visitor a plain-text copy of their results. The team is always notified at the address set on the Site Audit section.

fields.label: Add an AI-written summary
fields.name: site_audit_ai_summary
fields.instructions: Uses Claude to turn the scores into a plain-English verdict and top 3 fixes. Uses the API key and model from Theme Settings → AI Quote (the AI Quote toggle itself doesn't need to be on). Adds roughly 10–20 seconds to the audit.
